messages:
Tasha Reed: proposal: 75m webinar + mini-workshop: "Inference Playbooks: Configs, Costs, and Live Labs". aim=engineering + product leads. want practical how-tos and a short hands-on sandbox.
Omar Hassan: +1. target outcome: attendees leave with 3 concrete changes to reduce cost or improve latency.
Leah Park: suggested format: 1) 10m narrative (why) 2) 20m tech patterns (batching, cache, quant) 3) 20m live lab (capped seats) 4) 15m customer case + Q&A.
Jules Marin: registration fields: email, company, role, company_size, hosting_pref, interested_in_sandbox (yes/no), preferred_track (eng/product), utm_source. map sandbox opt-ins to Solutions Eng.
Ravi Shah: ops notes: cap workshop at 40 sandboxes; provision via hosted env. cost estimate in drive. add webhook mapping: form.email -> crm.email, form.hosting_pref -> crm.interest.hosting, form.sandbox -> crm.flags.sandbox.
Maya Li: messaging plan: A/B two subject lines and two landing pages (tech-first vs ROI-first). test CTA variants: "Reserve sandbox" vs "Request demo". measure signups -> demo requests.
Tasha Reed: run-of-show draft:
```
00:00 Intro & goals (5m)
05:00 Product + cost narrative (10m)
15:00 Engineering patterns (20m)
35:00 Live lab demo (20m)
55:00 Customer short case (8m)
63:00 Q&A & CTA (12m)
```
Omar Hassan: rehearsal plan: tech check 3 days prior (20m), full dress 2 days prior (60m). greenroom 15m before.
Leah Park: promo timeline: announce -21d, paid & partners -14d, reminders -7d/-1d/day-of. create 3 short social clips from the demo for post-webinar nurture.
Jules Marin: routing rules: company_size > 1000 OR hosting_pref == "private" -> enterprise AE. sandbox_opt_in -> tag "hands-on" and send to Solutions Eng queue. add utm campaign tag.
Ravi Shah: backup plan: if sandbox provisioning fails, fallback to pre-recorded lab + extended Q&A and signup for sandbox queue. engineer on-call during live.
Maya Li: creative needs: hero image, two landing pages, 3 social variants, 10s demo gif. deadline: assets in drive in 5 business days.
Tasha Reed: owners: Maya = creative & A/B test, Ravi = ops & fallback, Omar = lab script & sandbox infra, Leah = promo calendar & partners, Jules = reg form & CRM mapping. share progress here by EOD Friday.
Nora-bot: calendar event created: "Inference Playbooks: Configs, Costs, and Live Labs  final rehearsal" scheduled 2024-08-02T17:00Z. link: https://calendar.redwoodinference/internal/playbooks-123
Tasha Reed: great work. I'll draft the promo copy and drop it here tomorrow. :sparkles:
